purpose: Separate final selected-policy evidence from superseded and deliberately failing diagnostic runs.

final_source.note: The TP4 profiler captures use SHA256 34225bd3fa03639ecbc9311264e420d7a70c99772e6991f339cbe7107dca6f76. Later changes format one assignment, add the TP1 full-stack capacity guard, and disable the retained TP2 packed-expert copy; none changes the profiled TP4 hot path. Corrected TP1 boundary probes and final TP1/TP2 warmed traces ran on this exact hash.

final_test.note: The final test adds exact B32 metadata, strict TP2/TP4 same-input and chained stack gates, all-profile warmed timing, conservative capacity identities, real-weight BFP4 trials, and reproducible fractured-residual decision probes. Gate D now uses non-overlapping trace lifetimes, release-before-readback, 5 warmups, 30 individual samples with median/p95, and a fresh 20-replay stress trace. Hardware artifacts preserve their actual test hash at each run. Warmed TP1/TP2 traces bind to 9125621e...; TP4 stack binds to 5bd55e72...; BFP4 trials bind to 72adec37.... Corrected capacity JSONs preserve their earlier test hash 4db642db... and final measured decoder hash 7279e13a....
